headline: No API changes break the bot today and research was thin, so there are just two ideas: check whether you cut winners faster than losers, and judge funding against each coin's own normal instead of one fixed number.

ideas.title: Winners vs losers: hold time and size
ideas.why: Traders tend to grab small wins fast and sit in losers. /report and /week would show median minutes and average USDT for winning vs losing trades, e.g. "wins 3 min, +0.40 · losses 11 min, -0.95", so you see if your wins are too small to pay for your losses.

ideas.title: Crowded flag from each coin's own funding history
ideas.why: Crowded now fires at a fixed 0.05% funding. Some coins sit near that every day; others rarely pass 0.01%. Compare current funding to the coin's last 30 days and flag only when it's far outside its normal. Evidence that funding predicts moves is weak, so treat it as a 'size down' warning.
